title: Failure Loop Record
description: Record of one full revision loop: instruction, implementation, tests, review, and outcome. Only full loops count toward the two-failure takeover threshold; re-asking a question or regenerating an answer is not a loop.

loop_number.description: 1 = the initial implementation cycle, 2 = first revision cycle, and so on.

instruction.description: The instruction given to the implementer for this loop. For loops after the first, this must be an evidence-based revision instruction.

implementation_summary.description: What the implementer actually changed in this loop.

test_evidence.description: Verbatim excerpt of the real test output produced in this loop.

failure_reasons.description: Empty when the loop succeeded. Style or taste differences are never failure reasons.

counted_as_failure.description: True only when this was a full loop that ended in an objective failure. Two counted failures allow takeover.
